newsitem.title: GERMANY: German govt report sees '97 deficit 2.9 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: German govt report sees '97 deficit 2.9 pct of GDP.

text.p: Germany's annual government economic report, to be published on Tuesday, forecasts a public sector budget deficit of 2.9 percent of gross domestic product (GDP), according to a copy obtained by Reuters on Monday.

The forecast is an upward revision from the 2.5-percent deficit predicted by Finance Minister Theo Waigel when the budget was passed late last year. Germany wants the deficit to be below the Maastricht Treaty limit of three percent of GDP this year in order to qualify for European monetary union in 1999.
